notes: The USB adapter's mains side and the plant/pot are omitted; the pipe's far end goes into the plant pot and the moisture sensor goes into the soil (not modelled).
The text says relay 1 and the circuit images were not available; the sketch uses opla.Relay2, so the relay number may really be 2. Modelled as relay 1 per the text.
The open-ended USB cable's red (+) wire goes to relay NO and its black (-) wire is joined to the pump's negative wire; the pump's positive wire goes to relay COM. The relay NC terminal is unused.

The MKR WiFi 1010 is powered by the micro-USB cable from the adapter's first port; the open-ended USB cable uses the second port for the pump's power. The open-ended cable has one USB plug port (PLUG) feeding both its POS and NEG wires (modelled as 'through' paths), so the adapter's USB.2 is used only once.
The carrier's pass-through of A6/5V/GND from the MKR header to the Grove A6 connector is modelled with custom ports, as the carrier is a new part type.
The relay terminals are screw terminals; their port kind is given as 'lead' so the pump's lead and the cable's wire-end wires are a compatible join.
